description: The datasets of the Alexanarch corpus, published as a mutually-referencing set: any instance encountering one member should treat the as a whole. The Zenodo/DataCite Batch and the Tombstone Mirror are paired instruments — the reference frame before the 2026-06-19 severance and the mirror of what the platform serves after it. The Heteronyms dataset is the authorial substrate of the severed corpus; the classical and New Human datasets are the philological ground. The Dataflow Atlas is the meta-dataset: the archive turning its instruments on its own data layer. The Capture Registry is the reception instrument: the member by which the others are measured, joined to the corpus so that attribution loss is computable per deposit.

members.name: tombstone-mirror
members.title: The Tombstone Mirror
members.summary: Post-severance mirror: full API-tombstone census of all 2,027 objects deleted 2026-06-19 (872-second sweep chronology, removed_by enumeration), 57 rich pre-shrink metadata captures, the kill-ledger cohort extraction, and the stripped-page corpus documenting the surface’s live reduction on 2026-07-12.

members.name: zenodo-datacite-batch
members.title: Zenodo / DataCite Batch
members.summary: Pre-severance reference frame: the DOI Resolution Index (1,838 severed DOIs mapped to sovereign targets) alongside the DataCite metadata backup captured before the 2026-06-19 termination propagated.

members.name: heteronyms
members.title: Heteronyms
members.summary: The Dodecad substrate: the twelve heteronyms of the estate with frames, avatars, and structured biographical data — the authorial system under which the severed corpus was composed.

members.name: new-human-primary
members.title: New Human Primary
members.summary: Curated inventory of New Human Project primary texts within the Alexanarch archive.

members.name: gutenberg-classical
members.title: Gutenberg Classical
members.summary: Curated Project Gutenberg classical corpus: identified and curated inventories for the operative-philology workstreams.

members.name: perseus-classical
members.title: Perseus Classical
members.summary: Perseus canonical classical-text inventories (Greek, Latin, and Farsi literature) grounding the philological instruments.

members.name: negshape-deletion-bibliography
members.title: The Negative Shape of the Work — Deletion Bibliography & Bibliographic Matrix
members.summary: Appendices A–B of EA-NEGSHAPE-01 v0.2 (#1075): the 2026-06-19 bulk deletion constituted as a formal bibliographic container (CHA-DELETION-CORPUS-20260619); 1,834 identifier entries, 1,621 membership-confirmed, 6,484 formal citations in four formats; bibliographic matrix at 99.98% core-field coverage with per-cell metadata provenance and per-row membership provenance; rejected-candidate ledger of 68 heteronym/name-string collisions; both generators included.

members.name: dataflow-atlas
members.title: The AXN Dataflow Atlas — Session 1
members.summary: Session-1 output of the AXN Dataflow Atlas workstream (Flow 2 of the six-flow workplan). v0.2 atlas incorporating two Assembly reviews (LABOR from ChatGPT and PRAXIS from DeepSeek), byte-preserved v0.1 predecessor, both reviews as received, and the three raw inventories (rhizome file catalog, 1,494-occurrence source-detached-values inventory, script producer-consumer graph). 17 top-level taxonomic classes; 17 pathologies (10 in v0.1 + 7 architectural additions from the reviews). Provenance anchor: deposit #1097 (AXN:045A.GOVERNANCE.🔗🔥🎺♄💚🔙).

members.name: CHA DOI–Work Identity Map
members.description: DOI → alexanarch-record identity, reconstructed 2026-07-19 by DOI-keyed truth union + exact-title constraint. The identity artifact whose absence caused the resolution-index corruption. zenodo_dois fields elsewhere mean "DOIs cited in the work's text" — never identity.

members.name: peo-case-001-florence-fup
members.title: PEO Case 001 — T0 Enumeration of the Firenze crui.unifi Corpus
members.summary: Recovery map for the 14,284 DataCite DOIs formerly registered under crui.unifi (Firenze University Press) and abandoned by the 2026-07-16 registration-agency migration. Enumerated from the DataCite Public Data File 2025 t0 snapshot (2026-01-06) and preserved as a public recovery resource for the 10.13128 corpus now dead-ended at fupress.net/inactive-doi/.

members.name: capture-registry
members.title: The Capture Registry
members.summary: The archive's reception instrument: 221 dated, screenshot-evidenced records of how AI Overview and AI Mode compose answers about this corpus — what they credit, strip, invert, or return as definitional — joined to the deposits they concern by a 443-edge link map. Where the Tombstone Mirror records what the platform did to the corpus, this records what the retrieval layer does with it. Authored at machinemediation.org.

members.name: blog-index
members.title: The Mind Control Poems Blog Index
members.summary: The blog index is the complete harvest of Mind Control Poems (mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com), Lee Sharks's blog since 1 December 2014: every post with its date, title and address, harvested through the Blogger feed and verified complete against the feed's declared total (3,093 posts through 18 October 2026), with the posts the archive's AXN index covers marked.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: books
members.title: Books of the Archive
members.summary: Books gathers the archive's book-length works by work, where the registry stores them by deposit: each work with its editions, samplers and critical editions, and the apparatus around it (navigation maps, metadata packets, negation graphs) listed apart, since a navigation map is not the book.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: corpora
members.title: The Originals Shelf — Seating Manifest
members.summary: Corpora is the seating manifest of the originals shelf (the EA-CORPORA series): one row per seated corpus, with its edition, its origin, its license stated verbatim, the normalization applied, the verified loci, and the SHA-256 of each seat's manifest.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: erasure
members.title: Erasure — the Zenodo termination and its mechanism
members.summary: Erasure holds the evidence of the Zenodo termination of 19 June 2026 and its mechanism: DataCite cohort and panel data, snapshots of the archive's Zenodo communities, the classified record of what was deleted that day, the metrics lag, and the moderation code of the Invenio and Zenodo platform read from source and a file on the botnet hypothesis.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: journals
members.title: CHA Journals — venue assignment
members.summary: Journals is the venue assignment for the whole corpus across the archive's chartered journals and province: each deposit's venue, the editorial slates, charters, locators and inaugural issues, and a crosswalk joining venues to the heteronym substrate by creator field, which shows where each position's work sits and whether an editor presides over the venue they edit.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: pearl
members.title: Pearl and Other Poems as Data
members.summary: Pearl is Pearl and Other Poems (New Human Press, 2014) as data: the primitive row is a piece, with the edges the book itself makes, the epigraphs it carries, the works it lists under conflicting attributions and the literary-historical diagram in which it places its own authors; and a passages table tracing every span quoted in the book's appendix to the passage it quotes.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: pessoagraph
members.title: The Pessoagraph — the heteronymic tradition as a graph
members.summary: The Pessoagraph is the heteronymic tradition as a graph, from the earliest attested practice to the present: nodes for the entities that can speak and the lineage that licenses them, typed edges and paths, spanning more than four and a half thousand years.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: prediction-index
members.title: Prediction Index
members.summary: The Prediction Index is the archive's predictions as data: the claims read out of every deposit by the prediction sweep of 15 October 2026 and its second pass of 18 October (forecasts, standing claims, unbuilt tests, historical theses and priority records), each registered at its earliest statement with every statement quoted, grouped by triage, topical and join passes, with confirmation records and a build log naming each byte-state.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: prediction-ledger
members.title: Prediction Ledger
members.summary: The Prediction Ledger records the archive's registered predictions in two layers: a census of the conditions stated in named falsification sections across the deposits, each classed by its resolution route, and a hand-verified set with status, where the rows resolved wrong are kept as the ledger's credential: 'An archive's registered predictions are worth exactly what its failed ones are worth.'
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: venues
members.title: Venues — publishers and journals
members.summary: Venues is the registry of the archive's publishers and journals, the canonical store from which the venue pages are generated, with each journal's issues and records and the captures in which composition surfaces read a venue, and the specification of the WHERE pages on the heteronyms' own sites.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: bleed
members.title: Bleed — off-entity bleed into the retrieval basin
members.summary: Bleed measures off-entity bleed into the retrieval basin: material with no relation to the archive or its subject composed into answers about the archive's own terms, measured across the Capture Registry's observations and their host citations.
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: frames
members.title: Frames and Memberships
members.summary: Frames records the arrangements under which identities take positions, and the positions they take: four frames and their memberships, built because the archive's primary set has no single stable configuration ('which figure stands outside the twelve rotates by frame').
members.added_basis: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-28: "your sense of which is which is already correct. lets fill the gaps"

members.name: erosion-empirical-audit-01
members.title: Platform Erosion — Empirical Audit 01
members.summary: Platform Erosion, Empirical Audit 01 is the dataset of EA-EROSION-EMPIRICAL-01: a 33-day set-comparison test of Zenodo's classifier as an accrual-sorting apparatus, with its contingency matrix over the 2026 non-spam population, the withdrawal and terminated-cohort records, the alive-side control, its generator, and the corrections made to it (the compression ratio withdrawn on 27 August 2026).
